mission.title: Race: {Course}
mission.outline:
1. Set up: the course's line gives the Driving DIF. A race is usually three laps.
2. Each lap: every driver makes a Driving test against the DIF; those who succeed complete the lap. Count them in the Race and Chase Tracker, with Hazard as its hazard table.
3. Dirty tricks: a racer can attack instead (a vehicle weapon in Strike Mode, or a mask power) and drives with a Snag that lap.
4. The finish: the first to the last lap wins; ties go to the higher Driving total.
